Name: BirthdayMail
Author: MimisMods
Description:
[size=5]Summary:[/size]
This mod adds in an immersible way to remind the player about NPC birthdays.
Mail is sent from mayor Lewis. Every mail has additional flare text for the specific villager.
This is my first mod so go easy on me :3


[size=5]Install:[/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip contents of Mods folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
